expertise.title: What I bring
expertise.card1_p: Custom automations and AI agents. Repetitive tasks run themselves. Your team refocuses on what truly matters.
expertise.card2_p: Make your offer visible, test a market fast, structure and scale your outreach. Systems that generate activity at every stage of your growth.
expertise.card3_p: Framing and prioritization before writing code. You don't pay to explore, you pay for what actually matters.
expertise.card4_p: 3 years as Data PM at Decathlon building indicators for marketing teams across 60+ countries. Knowing what to measure, how to track it, and what to do with it.

apropos.title: About
apropos.intro: Three years at Decathlon designing data systems for marketing teams across 60 countries. I came away with an obsession: build things that are reliable, useful, and never lose sight of what they're for. Since then I've built for organizations of every size and sector, with a marked preference for those whose work has a positive impact.
apropos.quote_title: I don't build tech for tech's sake. Same with AI.
apropos.quote_body: What drives me is your mission: what you'll teach me about your business, and how I can help you operate more efficiently.

footer.desc: Passionate about trail running, I know you can't go the distance by sprinting head-down. I work in short cycles and only commit to what I can deliver fast.
